slots.description: The title: the row's accessible name; the description, the tags and the trailing content never join it.

slots.name: icon
slots.description: One icon before the title (the slot convention): `--ocelle-icon-size` square, decorative.

slots.name: description
slots.description: Elements whose text describes the row, after the title; an element without non-whitespace text contributes nothing, and a slot with no such element takes no space.

slots.name: tags
slots.description: Elements whose text describes the row after the description, laid out as one group with the trailing icon; a slot with no element holding text takes no space.

slots.name: trailing
slots.description: One icon at the end of the row (the slot convention), for example `arrow-end`.

declarations.name: OcelleActionRow

members.name: rowId
members.description:
The row's id, carried by its `ocelle-action-row-activate` event as `detail.rowId` (`""` when absent). Reflected as
`row-id`.

members.name: label
members.description:
The accessible name of the row, trimmed; empty or whitespace-only counts as none, and the name is then the title.
Not reflected.

members.name: layout
members.description:
`row` (icon, title and description, then the tags and the trailing icon, on one line; the tags and the trailing
icon move to a second line together when the line cannot hold them) or `card`; absent or any other value renders
`row`. Reflected.

members.name: presentation
members.description:
`default` (a bordered row on a surface) or `flush` (no border and no surface, the compact navigation density);
absent or any other value renders `default`. Reflected.

members.name: ground
members.description:
The ground the row sits on: `accent-low`, `inset`, `hover-bg` or `state` (a state ground) give a default row an
`--ocelle-color-accent-strong` border; `chrome` gives the chrome look for the chrome grounds; absent or any other
value means the other main grounds. Reflected.

members.name: href
members.description:
The link's URL: a non-empty `href` that parses as a URL and is not a `javascript:` URL makes the row a link (an
inner `<a>` with the `href` as written); any other value is button mode. Reflected.

members.name: target
members.description: The inner link's `target`, in link mode; with `_blank` and no `rel` the link gets `rel="noopener"`. Reflected.

members.name: rel
members.description: The inner link's `rel`, in link mode. Reflected.

members.name: current
members.description:
`page` or `true`: the row is the current item, reported as `aria-current` with that value on the inner control and
drawn with the current mark (an `--ocelle-color-accent-low` surface, `--ocelle-color-chrome-hover` on chrome, and
a bar in `--ocelle-color-current` at the inline start, apart from the focus ring), which stays on hover; absent or
any other value is not current. Reflected.

members.name: unavailable
members.description:
Unavailable: the row exists but cannot be used right now. Its inner control stays in the tab order, reports
`aria-disabled="true"`, keeps its name and description and is not activated (no event, no click past the element,
no navigation: a link row has no `href`); it shows the disabled ink and no hover. Reflected.

members.name: busy
members.description:
Busy: the row's content is updating; its inner control reports `aria-busy`, and activation still dispatches the
event. Reflected.

members.name: click
members.description: Clicks the inner control, so the click passes through it and the row is activated as by any other click.

events.name: ocelle-action-row-activate
events.description: Dispatched from the element on each activation (a pointer click, Enter, Space in button mode, `click()`), before a link's navigation; bubbles, composed and cancelable, `detail` `{ rowId }`, the current `row-id` or `""`; `preventDefault()` cancels a link's navigation. Not dispatched for a Ctrl, Meta, Shift or Alt click or a middle click in link mode, nor while the row is unavailable.

declarations.description:

members.name: variant
members.description:

its hover surface and focus ring. Reflected.

members.description:

members.name: disabled
members.description:
Disabled: out of the tab order, reported disabled and not activated (no `click`, no `ocelle-button-activate`).
Reflected.

members.name: busy
members.description:
Busy: while a host waits for the result of an action the button is unavailable (in the tab order and focusable,
`aria-disabled`, not activated: no `click`, no `ocelle-button-activate`), reports `aria-busy`, and shows a spinner in
the icon's place (six turns in 4.8 s, then still; still under reduced motion); a busy link has no `href`.
`disabled` wins. Reflected.

members.name: href
members.description:
The link's URL: a non-empty `href` that parses as a URL and is not a `javascript:` URL puts the button in link mode
(an inner `<a>` with the `href` as written); any other value is button mode. Reflected.

members.name: click
members.description:
Clicks the inner control, so the click passes through it and is guarded like any other: a disabled button ignores

events.name: ocelle-button-activate
events.description: Dispatched from the element on each activation that delivers a `click` (a pointer click, Enter, Space in button mode, `click()`), before the `click` reaches any bubble-phase listener on the element or its ancestors; bubbles, composed and cancelable, `detail` `{}`. Calling `preventDefault()` on it cancels the click's default action (in link mode the navigation; in button mode the `click` is still delivered). Not dispatched for a link-mode click with Ctrl, Meta, Shift or Alt held, nor for a middle click. A disabled or busy button dispatches neither.

declarations.description:
A native button in the Ocelle look, or a link that looks like one: three variants, two sizes, a flush look, the
ground it sits on, a label, a disabled and a busy state, an icon slot, link mode with `href`, and host ARIA moved onto
the inner control.
